job.title: [Post] ... looking for an experienced Salesforce B2C Commerce Architect with: • 10 ... Salesforce…

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce B2C Commerce Architect
cover_en.hook: I am very interested in contributing my enterprise e-commerce platform expertise to your upcoming initiatives. With over 5 years of hands-on backend and platform delivery experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I specialize in building robust B2B and B2C commerce solutions, complex API integrations, and scalable architectures.

bullets.label: Enterprise Commerce Platform Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented core backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: Headless & OCC REST API Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators and Converters for seamless data flows.

bullets.label: Complex Data & System Integrations
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, resolving integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Performance & Deployment Engineering
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud CCv2 and led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my enterprise commerce background aligns with your team's goals.

tailoring.why_company: I want to apply my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce platform engineering and integration experience to help architect scalable, high-performing digital commerce solutions for your business. My background in building complex B2B and B2C platforms, headless APIs, and robust data pipelines at Rockwell Automation and Shell aligns strongly with delivering impactful commerce architectures.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise B2B/B2C commerce, Java, and API integration expertise to drive high-performing digital platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi Jumana, I saw your post looking for commerce platform expertise. With 5+ years building enterprise B2B/B2C e-commerce solutions, headless APIs, and integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would love to connect. I am available from Dec 16, 2026. Let's talk!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Salesforce B2C Commerce Architect - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Ms Jumana A,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the commerce architect opportunity. With over 5 years of professional experience building and scaling enterprise B2B and B2C e-commerce platforms, RESTful APIs, and complex data integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical delivery expertise.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and can start from 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
